content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(A user received multiple weakly encrypted service tickets) AND ABIOC(A user authenticated with weak NTLM to multiple hosts) on the same principal_name (the realm-stripped sAMAccountName) within a 60-minute window — fuses the weakly-encrypted service-ticket roast burst and the subsequent NTLM Pass-the-Hash network logon on the same identity into a single credential-abuse incident anchored to the requesting-identity causality chain (foothold auth, weak-ticket roast, NTLM lateral logon).
rules.name: Kerberoast-to-Pass-the-Hash Ticket-Abuse Chain — ABIOC Causality Stitch
